item: ATL@MIL 2026-11-15 (game 0022600243): two official documents disagree on one quarter score
why: The official statsdmz game-book period table prints MIL Q3=37 (that reading sums to 116, not the printed final 106). The official game-page LINESCORES table gives MIL Q3=27 (sums to 106) and the AP recap on the same game page says Milwaukee led 87-80 after three quarters, which requires Q3=27. Both readings are official; the repository does not repair them.
action_needed: Owner decision: ask the league/game-book publisher which period table is correct. Until then the row publishes the game-page LINESCORES value (27) with the conflict recorded on the row and the game-book transcription left untouched.

item: The reports between 2026-11-15 06:15 AM ET and 2026-11-16 01:15 PM ET (the official index listed 53 reports on 11/16 alone) are not archived in this session
why: The brief says store every injury PDF with its timestamp and diff consecutive reports. This session archived the newest report of 11/16 (01:15 PM) against the last archived one (11/15 06:15 AM), so the consecutive diff spans a gap; a status change inside the gap cannot be dated.
action_needed: The scheduled refresh now archives every report listed on the official index that is not yet indexed (refresh_official.py: verbatim pdftotext text + the PDF's URL, sha256 at retrieval and retrieval stamp per report), so the gap closes going forward; the historical gap is documented, not backfilled.

item: The 2026-11-16 01:15 PM ET PDF's page breaks shift columns: the GSW@NOP block drops one column (Butler III, Jimmy's row shows a reason with no status; five rows show a status with no reason), and two rows (Reese, Julian; Watford, Trendon) lost every leading cell
why: Reading those rows positionally would invent a status or a team. The archive parser reads only rows with a recognisable status and publishes the damaged rows as UNATTRIBUTED/UNPARSEABLE with their raw cells kept.
action_needed: If the statuses of those rows matter for a decision, read the original PDF at the source link; do not let the diff tool's numbers be used for them.

item: The 2026-11-13 rows (nine games) are settled on the verified final score alone: their quarter scores were never captured and the feed says so in every row's quarter_check and settlement stamp
why: Settling on the verified final is allowed by the settlement rule, but the quarter columns are blank for those nine rows while every other settled row carries them.
action_needed: Backfill the 11/13 quarter scores from each game's official summary-page LINESCORES the next time those pages are captured; until then the blanks stand and are visible.

item: Per-player logs (MIN/PTS/REB/AST + opponent) are captured for the five 2026-11-14 game books; the 2026-11-15 game books exist as official URLs but their box scores are not yet transcribed
why: The brief asks for game logs at least for players named on an injury report; the 11/15 injury-report names include players whose 11/15 lines are not in the log yet.
action_needed: Transcribe the nine 11/15 game books with the existing strict parser (scripts/parse_gamebook.py, four arithmetic identities per book) and re-cut minutes shares; the sources are listed per game on app/settlement.html.

item: The originated-lines window is priced for 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-18; the four games of 2026-11-19 (0022600270-0022600273) are on the official schedule strip but are not priced in the pinned round artefacts
why: The brief allows picks up to three days ahead; the round model window is a frozen replay (data/rounds/2026-11-16) whose tests pin its contents, so widening it is an owner decision, not a quiet edit.
action_needed: Owner decision on re-cutting the round window to today..today+3 as a new dated round; the scheduled refresh already carries the 11/19 games in its rolling slate capture.
